benchmark.command: (cd client-wasm && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --release) && node client-wasm/benchmark.mjs 30 paper/experiments/reconstruction_wasm.csv
benchmark.aggregation: median, arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation, and nearest-rank P95 after one untimed warm-up proof
benchmark.clock: js_sys::Date::now wall-clock milliseconds inside the wasm32 boundary

native_benchmark.aggregation: median, arithmetic mean, sample standard deviation, and nearest-rank P95

component_profile.aggregation: median over 30 samples; nanoseconds in component CSV
component_profile.sum_tolerance: component sums may exceed total by at most 25 percent because stages are timed in separate calls

scoped_baseline.scope: single-slot arithmetic selector relation only; excludes ElGamal, shuffle, cross-key proofs, authenticated state, and dropout composition
scoped_baseline.toolchain: Circom 2.2.3, snarkjs 0.7.5, BN128, local throwaway Powers of Tau

scope_and_limits: These are Node/V8 host measurements, not Chrome, Safari, Android, or iOS device measurements.
The CSV reports warm-start median, mean, sample standard deviation, and P95 wall time; true cold module initialization and browser peak memory were not recorded.
The benchmark validates the production Borsh/browser bundle boundary and proof acceptance; it is not an end-to-end network-latency measurement.
